title: Millwrights
description: Install, dismantle, or move machinery and heavy equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, or other drawings.

tasks.text: Replace defective parts of machine, or adjust clearances and alignment of moving parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Align machines or equipment, using hoists, jacks, hand tools, squares, rules, micrometers, lasers, or plumb bobs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical alignment of machinery requires hands

dwas.name: Align equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Insert shims, adjust tension on nuts and bolts, or position parts, using hand tools and measuring instruments, to set specified clearances between moving and stationary parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual torqueing of nuts and bolts

dwas.name: Adjust the tension of nuts or bolts.
Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Signal crane operator to lower basic assembly units to bedplate, and align unit to centerline.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Install/repair coordination is situated teamwork

dwas.name: Align equipment or machinery.
Communicate with coworkers to coordinate installations or repairs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Conduct preventative maintenance and repair, and lubricate machines and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.
Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Assemble and install equipment, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Assemble machines, and bolt, weld, rivet, or otherwise fasten them to foundation or other structures, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Bolting objects is physical manipulation

dwas.name: Bolt objects into place.
Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.
Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Move machinery and equipment, using hoists, dollies, rollers, and trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Move materials, equipment, or supplies.
Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Level bedplate and establish centerline, using straightedge, levels, and transit.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on leveling of machines with tools

dwas.name: Level machines or equipment.

tasks.text: Dismantle machines, using hammers, wrenches, crowbars, and other hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Dismantling heavy machinery is physical trade work

dwas.name: Dismantle heavy equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Bolt parts, such as side and deck plates, jaw plates, and journals, to basic assembly unit.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Bolting objects is physical manipulation

dwas.name: Bolt objects into place.

tasks.text: Lay out mounting holes, using measuring instruments, and drill holes with power drill.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.
Lay out work according to specifications.

tasks.text: Attach moving parts and subassemblies to basic assembly unit, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Weld, repair, and fabricate equipment or machinery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.
Operate welding equipment.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Shrink-fit bushings, sleeves, rings, liners, gears, and wheels to specified items, using portable gas heating equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of heating/drying equipment

dwas.name: Operate heating or drying equipment.

tasks.text: Troubleshoot equipment, electrical components, hydraulics, or other mechanical systems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Troubleshooting aided; hands-on diagnosis human

dwas.name: Troubleshoot equipment or systems operation problems.

tasks.text: Dismantle machinery and equipment for shipment to installation site, performing installation and maintenance work as part of team.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Dismantling heavy machinery is physical trade work

dwas.name: Dismantle heavy equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Connect power unit to machines or steam piping to equipment, and test unit to evaluate its mechanical operation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Position steel beams to support bedplates of machines and equipment, using blueprints and schematic drawings to determine work procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual tool and equipment positioning in field

dwas.name: Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Fabricate and dismantle parts, equipment, and machines, using a cutting torch or other cutting equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Construct foundation for machines, using hand tools and building materials such as wood, cement, and steel.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Operate engine lathe to grind, file, and turn machine parts to dimensional specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Precision grinding requires hands-on machine control

dwas.name: Grind parts to required dimensions.

tasks.text: Install robot and modify its program, using teach pendant.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Program installation on equipment needs physical access

dwas.name: Install programs onto computer or computer-controlled equipment.

emerging_tasks.task: Inventory and store parts, tools, and equipment.
